title: ARS Production Coord Agent — Input
description: Validates the input shape consumed by the ARS Production Coord Agent v1.0. Authored from Production Coord Agent SPEC §2 (LOCKED 5/3/2026 — Day 14 Rest Day) against Cross-SPEC Consistency Review §3 canon. Polymorphic storyboard accept (success | errorEnvelope) lets the runtime branch cleanly with a Step-1 halt on storyboard_not_success.

storyboard.description: Storyboard Agent v1.0 output object. Either successStoryboard variant (consumed normally) OR errorEnvelope variant — Production Coord Agent must halt with storyboard_not_success at Step 1. Polymorphic accept follows the same Cross-SPEC §3.8 pattern as Script→Storyboard.

oneOf.description: successStoryboard — required-field signature; full validation against storyboard-agent/output.schema.json successStoryboard variant happens at runtime.
errorEnvelope — emitted by Storyboard Agent when upstream validation failed. Production Coord Agent halts with storyboard_not_success.

brief.description: Pass-through Brief Agent successBrief output (denormalized for self-containment). Production Coord re-reads do_not_say + entity-firewall vocab here for 4th defense-in-depth pass without re-calling the Brief Agent.

script.description: Pass-through Script Agent successScript output (denormalized for self-containment). Provides script_id audit context for parent_chain metadata + line-level reference for shoot blocking.

lever_state.description: 3 = full human approval, 2 = sampled, 1 = full autonomy.

production_mode.description: Inherited from brief. Re-validated against tier as 4th defense-in-depth pass.

videographer_registry.description: Mode A only — available shooters with day-rates, equipment tier, and calendar windows.

talent_registry.description: Mode A only — speakers/on-camera people. v1.0 = single-talent (Jamila for REINVENTED). Multi-talent v1.1+.

location_registry.description: Mode A only — interior/closed-set locations. no_buildings_compliant_bool surfaces the brand-firewall constraint at registry level.

equipment_inventory.description: Mode A only — gear keyed by equipment tier (S/M/L). Owned vs. rentable.

weather_api_handle.description: Mode A only — opaque forecast lookup id. v1.0 expects pre-fetched forecast values via the orchestrator; the agent does not call external APIs.

ai_render_quotas.description: Mode B only — remaining render seconds per engine.

style_token_lib.description: Mode B only — REINVENTED-specific style tokens cached for prompt-seed binding.

cost_floor_per_reel.description: Mode B only — internal cost ceiling per Pricing Model 4/25 §6 margin floor 5×.

mode_c_reference_cache.description: Mode C only — pre-downloaded reference frames keyed by source_url + offset_s. Cache hit avoids re-download.

style_match_thresholds.description: Mode C only — minimum acceptance scores per axis for replication match.

prior_production_plans.description: Up to 5 most recent production_plan.json objects for this brand. Oldest first. Used for vendor rotation, cost-baseline drift detection, and time-baseline learning.

escalation_contacts.description: Operator on-call, billing approver, vendor contacts for Mode A bookings.
